Test 1 - Bid Flood: Flood the Auction Submit Bid endpoint with 5,000 requests/second. Verify the Redis Stream consumer lag doesn't exceed 100ms and does NOT crash PostgreSQL.
Test 2 - HPA Autoscale: Monitor Kubernetes CPU. Verify the HPA automatically spins up new auction-engine pods to handle the load.
Test 3 - Offline Queue: Simulate a network drop on 10,000 virtual React Native instances. Verify the Zustand stores persist the local queue across app restarts.
Setup: 1. node load-tests/seed-tokens.js 1000 > /tmp/k6-tokens.json  2. Note an ACTIVE auction ID from the seed.js output  3. AUCTION_ID=<id> k6 run --vus 10000 --duration 60s load-tests/bid-flood.js
